paperTitleZh: 生物 全新模擬卷 — 卷二 丁部 生物工程
paperTitle: Biology Mock — Paper 2 Section D Biotechnology

parts.label: a(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 解釋為什麼要先以 PCR 擴增鱗片的 DNA。（2 分）
parts.questionTextEn: Explain why the DNA from the scales has to be amplified by PCR first. (2 marks)

parts.label: a(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 參考圖 1，解釋為什麼在樣本 S2 中，代表 11 個重複單位的帶比代表 14 個重複單位的帶離加樣孔較遠。（2 分）
parts.questionTextEn: With reference to Figure 1, explain why, in sample S2, the band representing 11 repeat units is further from the well than the band representing 14 repeat units. (2 marks)

parts.label: a(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 參考表 1，推論這 6 塊鱗片最少來自多少隻穿山甲，並解釋你的答案。（3 分）
parts.questionTextEn: With reference to Table 1, deduce the minimum number of pangolins from which these 6 scales came, and explain your answer. (3 marks)

parts.label: a(iv)
parts.questionTextZh: 有人認為只分析一個 STR 位點便足以判斷鱗片是否來自同一隻穿山甲。參考表 1 評論這說法。（3 分）
parts.questionTextEn: Someone claimed that analysing only one STR locus is enough to determine whether scales came from the same pangolin. Comment on this claim with reference to Table 1. (3 marks)

parts.label: b(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 以重組卵的數目計算，克隆的整體成功率（存活超過一年的個體）是多少？以百分率表示。（2 分）
parts.questionTextEn: Based on the number of reconstructed eggs, what is the overall success rate of cloning (individuals surviving for more than one year)? Express your answer as a percentage. (2 marks)

parts.label: b(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 解釋為什麼必須先除去家牛卵的細胞核。（2 分）
parts.questionTextEn: Explain why the nucleus of the domestic cow egg must be removed first. (2 marks)

parts.label: b(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 克隆出來的野牛並非與捐出細胞核的野牛 E 完全一樣。提出兩個原因。（2 分）
parts.questionTextEn: The cloned ox is not completely identical to the wild ox E that donated the nucleus. Suggest two reasons. (2 marks)

parts.label: b(iv)
parts.questionTextZh: 評價以體細胞核移植技術保育野牛 E。（4 分）
parts.questionTextEn: Evaluate the use of somatic cell nuclear transfer in conserving wild ox E. (4 marks)
